source: To approach peak matrix throughput, a workload must provide supported data types and tile shapes, enough parallel work, high operand reuse, sufficient instruction issue, and a data pipeline that keeps the matrix units supplied. Real models also execute non-matrix kernels and incur memory movement, synchronization, communication, launch, and framework overhead.
zh: 为了接近峰值矩阵吞吐量，工作负载必须提供支持的数据类型和切片形状、足够的并行工作、高操作数重用、足够的指令发出以及保持矩阵单元供应的数据管道。真实模型还执行非矩阵内核并产生内存移动、同步、通信、启动和框架开销。
